faqs.q: Can checklists adapt to different project types?
faqs.a: Yes, configure logic-driven inspection templates that route based on live site input, with offline capture for remote sites.

faqs.q: How are defects assigned and tracked?
faqs.a: Non-conformances are pinned to plans or BIM models, assigned to an owner, and tracked through resolution with a full audit trail.
Inspection status flows into the live quality analytics grid and portfolio reporting for immediate oversight.
